reason: I grab my drink at the station shop on the way to the tram, and this isn't there, so I'm not ordering cans online or hunting for a particular bistro. The price doesn't bother me, but YEAHRBA on Rohlík already covers yerba mate if I want it.
objection: It says fruit concentrate but shows no sugar number, so I can't tell if it actually fits my zero-sugar rule, and 'natural' is on every can these days.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the station shop fridge with a clear 'X g sugar per can' on the front, ideally close to zero.
